def object_hook(self, obj):
    if 'old_type' in obj and 'new_type' in obj:
        for type_key in ('old_type', 'new_type'):
            type_str = obj[type_key]
            obj[type_key] = TYPE_STR_TO_TYPE.get(type_str, type_str)
    return obj
